_doc: Shared copy and dismissal rule for the map's first-visit hint and empty states (#828). Read by Ortho4XP/tests/test_map_guidance.py (O4_Map_Guidance) and Tests/SceneryKitTests/MapGuidanceTests.swift (SceneryKit MapGuidance).

copy.hint: Search your airport, or click its square on the map.
copy.empty_selection: Nothing is selected yet. A tile is one 1° × 1° square of the map. Building it downloads imagery and elevation for that square and fits the runways, taxiways and aprons of every airport in it to the terrain.
copy.nothing_built: No tiles built yet. Search your airport or click its square, then press Build.
